7-586-728-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

141-4247-7446.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonland permanent card in your graveyard.
141-4247-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Naru Meha, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-5256-7192.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7328-7913.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7328-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

1322-1563-2457-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1368-3755-6321-6791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-6321-6791.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2180-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2180-6797-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-3921-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Winding Constrictor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1029-2464-7010.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1029-2464-7010.description:
Activate Gran-Gran by tapping it, adding {1}.
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Gran-Gran.
Repeat.

851-1274-2034-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-1274-2034-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2692-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

290-1456-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

252-2073-4659--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

1020-2866-6518-6556.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1117-2146-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4050-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
4050-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
4050-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

678-2829-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
678-2829-4766.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4867-5487.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Cormela.
Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2837-4875-5331.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}.
When Gemcutter Buccaneer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat or Dog enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

880-2653-4862.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1479-3147-3875.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-3875.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Provisioner, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1786-2173-5078.description:
Activate Sense's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2174-3525-3573.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.
You control at least two artifacts.
2174-3525-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
